title: An item done in place (a review or research story) keeps run claimed after its sprint closes, and runs --reconcile calls it released
goal: an item `done --commit` finishes in its own checkout, with no land, ends at run state landed, and `runs --reconcile` moves a run key whose item a sprint close deleted to the state its done commit shows, never to released

run:
import json, os, re, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
R = os.getcwd(); T = os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp())
S = os.path.join(T, "coord.sqlite")
env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("GIT_")}
env.update(KB_COORD_STORE=S, KB_SYNC_NO_TESTS="1")
def sh(*a, cwd=None):
    return subprocess.run(a, cwd=cwd or T, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
O = os.path.join(T, "origin.git"); K = os.path.join(T, "clone")
sh("git", "init", "-q", "--bare", "-b", "main", O)
sh("git", "clone", "-q", O, K)
for k, v in (("user.email", "a@example.com"), ("user.name", "n")):
    sh("git", "config", k, v, cwd=K)
cfg = json.load(open(os.path.join(R, "backlog.json")))
cfg["review_checks"] = [{"run": ["python3", "_tools/backlog.py", "check"]}]
json.dump(cfg, open(os.path.join(K, "backlog.json"), "w"))
os.makedirs(os.path.join(K, "kb", "_self", "backlog"))
shutil.copytree(os.path.join(R, "_tools"), os.path.join(K, "_tools"), ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "*.pyc", "fixtures", "test_*.py"))
sh("git", "add", ".", cwd=K); sh("git", "commit", "-q", "-m", "base", cwd=K)
sh("git", "push", "-q", "origin", "HEAD:main", cwd=K); sh("git", "fetch", "-q", cwd=K)
bl = lambda *a: sh(sys.executable, os.path.join(R, "_tools", "backlog.py"), "--root", K, *a, cwd=K)
out = bl("new", "sprint", "--title", "Planted sprint", "--goal", "g", "--commit").stdout
ids = re.findall(r"\b(?:SP|ST)-[a-z0-9]{8}\b", out)
sp = next((i for i in ids if i.startswith("SP-")), None)
review = re.search(r"review story (ST-[a-z0-9]{8})", out)
research = re.search(r"research story (ST-[a-z0-9]{8})", out)
if not (sp and review and research):
    print("check broken: new sprint printed no ids:", out[-300:]); sys.exit(2)
review, research = review.group(1), research.group(1)
bl("set", research, "--notes", "No outside facts: planted.")
sh("git", "commit", "-q", "-am", "notes", cwd=K)
bl("answer", sp, "start", "--answer", "approve", "--by", "operator")
bl("start", sp)
sh("git", "commit", "-q", "-am", "start", cwd=K)
steps = []
for iid in (research, review):
    steps.append(bl("claim", iid, "--by", "claude-0000aaaa", "--commit"))
    steps.append(bl("done", iid, "--commit"))
closed = bl("close", sp, "--commit")
if closed.returncode != 0:
    print("check broken: the planted sprint did not close:", [s.returncode for s in steps], (closed.stdout + closed.stderr)[-400:]); sys.exit(2)
problems = []
for iid in (research, review):
    g = sh(sys.executable, os.path.join(R, "_tools", "coord.py"), "--store", S, "get", "run/" + iid)
    state = json.loads(g.stdout).get("value") if g.returncode == 0 else None
    if state not in (None, "landed"):
        problems.append("run/%s is still %r after done in place and close" % (iid, state))
d = bl("runs", "--reconcile")
if re.search(r"run claimed\s+file no item file", d.stdout):
    problems.append("runs --reconcile leaves a closed sprint's item at run claimed: " + d.stdout[-200:])
print("\n".join(problems) or "ok")
sys.exit(1 if problems else 0)

notes: Seen 2026-10-26 on SP-wurbmsid and SP-eyhift2n: each review and research story finished with `done --commit` in the orchestrator's checkout stayed at run claimed; after `close` deleted the item files, `runs --reconcile` reported 0 reconciled and kbmon raised a run-drift alert; the orchestrator repaired them with `coord.py transition run/ID --to landed`. In the repro, reconcile moves one of the two to released, a state that claims the item was let go undone. Module: done in bl_land.py, runs in bl_runs.py; close (bl_close.py) needs no change if done moves the state.
